subject: Request: Temporary log retention & evidence for upcoming audit (HealthBridge)
messages:
From: Carolyn Smith <carolyn.smith@healthbridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Temporary log retention & evidence for upcoming audit

Hi Mina,

We're running a scoped compliance audit (internal QA + third-party auditor) for HealthBridge's tenant (org ID HB-907) the week of Nov 8. The auditor has requested access to request logs, auth traces, and the relevant KV-cache access events for Aug 1–Oct 31, 2026. Our DPA default retention would have some of those log segments purged on Oct 25 — can Redwood pause purge for the affected objects and provide a verifiable export (immutable copy + manifest) that we can include in the evidence package?

Specifically we'd like:
- A freeze of automated purge for HB-907 logs from Oct 20 through Nov 30 (or until we confirm evidence ingestion).
- An immutable snapshot / export of request logs + KV-access traces for Aug 1–Oct 31 (CSV/NDJSON preferred).
- A signed manifest (SHA256 checksums) for exported files and chain-of-custody notes.

We understand subprocessors may be involved in backups/archival. Please confirm which subprocessors will touch exported data and whether any cross-border transfer disclosures apply. Our security/compliance team will need the evidence pack and a short statement that retention was extended only for this scoped audit under our DPA.

I've attached a short scoped request from our legal team. Let me know the earliest you can commit to a timeline and any blockers.

Thanks,
Carolyn
Carolyn Smith
Senior Compliance Manager
HealthBridge Therapeutics
[Attachment: HealthBridge_Scoped-Audit_Request.pdf]
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Smith <carolyn.smith@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary log retention & evidence for upcoming audit

Hi Carolyn — thanks for the clear ask and the PDF. We can support a scoped retention extension and provide an export + manifest, but I want to confirm a few details and propose an execution plan so you can get this into the auditor's evidence timeline.

Questions:
- Confirm that HB-907 is the only tenant affected and the exact object sets to include (request logs, auth traces, KV-access events). If there are additional event streams (ingestion or webhook logs), please list them.
- Do you require the exported files in NDJSON or CSV? NDJSON is preferable for fidelity.
- Will the auditor require direct access to our S3 export or just the files/manifest delivered to you?

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Oct 20: Create an immutable snapshot of the requested datasets for HB-907 (we'll tag the snapshot with HB-907-AUDIT-2026-10-20).
2) Oct 21–22: Export snapshot to a customer-restricted S3 bucket (read-only link for HealthBridge auditors).
3) Oct 22: Generate signed manifest (SHA256) and short chain-of-custody statement.
4) Oct 22–Nov 30: Keep purge jobs disabled for objects matching HB-907 (scoped rule).
5) Nov 30 (or upon confirmation of ingestion): schedule purge resume unless we receive written hold extension.

Action items for us: I'll coordinate with Infra (Karthik) to confirm purge windows and the export playbook; Legal (Laura) will confirm a short DPA addendum language that documents the temporary extension and subprocessors; Product (Marcus) will validate impact to SLAs and any customer-facing limits.

I've attached a short acknowledgement + proposed plan file. If this works, please confirm the dataset list and preferred export format and we'll lock in the timeline.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: initial-ack-proposed-plan.txt]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2026 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary log retention & evidence for upcoming audit

Mina — quick technical notes and a feasible plan from Infra: 

Summary of constraints:
- Daily purge job (purged-batches) runs on Tuesdays at 02:00 UTC; the Oct 25 window Carolyn mentioned is the next scheduled run that would affect the older segments.
- Request logs and auth traces are stored in warm storage with a rolling TTL; KV-access traces are derived: we keep access indices for 90d by default but some older shards are compacted sooner.

Suggested low-risk execution (we can do this within your proposed dates):
A) On Oct 20 (pre-purge): create a scoped index snapshot for HB-907; mark the snapshot immutable in our metadata service (tag + prevent compaction).
B) Export snapshot as NDJSON to a locked S3 bucket under redwood-internal-exports/hb-907-audit/ (bucket policies: encrypted, restricted to redwood/auditor principals; lifecycle: 90d).
C) Generate hb-evidence-manifest-sha256.txt with file-level checksums and a short export log that includes exporter user, timestamp, and run-id. We'll sign it with our key.
D) Implement a temporary purge-exemption rule: purge-exclude:tenant=HB-907 effective Oct 20 02:00 UTC -> Nov 30 23:59 UTC (admin can extend by request).

Risks / notes:
- There is a small storage cost for keeping the snapshot and preventing compaction — product should sign off.
- If HealthBridge requires the data to leave our control (they ask for transfer to their cloud), we must enumerate subprocessors (S3 provider, transfer agents) and update DPA addendum accordingly.

I'll attach the export playbook and the TTL schedules for the affected indices. If legal wants a line to be added about subprocessors, we should draft that with Laura.

-Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
[Attachment: kvlog-export-playbook.md] [Attachment: ttl-schedule.csv]
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Smith <carolyn.smith@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary log retention & evidence for upcoming audit

Hi Carolyn — confirming the plan and timeline below. Thank you for the prompt turnaround on the dataset list; NDJSON is fine and preferred for fidelity.

Confirmed scope: HB-907 — request logs, auth traces, KV-access events for Aug 1–Oct 31, 2026.
Execution and deliverables: 
- Oct 20: Immutable snapshot created and tagged HB-907-AUDIT-2026-10-20.
- Oct 21 (completed): Export to locked S3 location and initial verification run.
- Oct 22: Deliverables uploaded and shared to your compliance folder; we will provide a read-only signed link.
- Deliverables: NDJSON exports, hb-evidence-manifest-sha256.txt (signed), export-run-log.txt (includes run-id and operator), short chain-of-custody statement.
- Purge window: purge jobs will be disabled for objects matching tenant=HB-907 from Oct 20 through Nov 30. If you need the hold extended beyond Nov 30 please provide written request by Nov 25.

Subprocessors and transfers:
- Exports will be stored in our AWS S3 bucket (subprocessor: Amazon Web Services). If you instruct us to transfer the exported files to HealthBridge-controlled storage, we will prepare a subprocessor/transfer addendum and share that with Legal (Laura).

Access to evidence: shared folder link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-HB-audit-evidence

Next steps for you: Confirm acceptance of the NDJSON format and whether you want us to deliver files to Redwood-controlled S3 (read-only link to you) or transfer files directly to HealthBridge cloud. Once we have that, we will close the loop on the DPA addendum language.

I'll also have Laura draft the one-paragraph DPA extension language referencing the temporary retention carveout and the subprocessors that touched the data.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: hb-evidence-manifest-sha256.txt]
